blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s main gateway saw a busier-than-expected Undas season, with passenger traffic growing faster than expected during the nine-day travel period despite elevated airfares. A total of 1.29 million passengers passed through Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) from Oct. 27 to Nov. 4, according to its private operator, New Naia Infra Corp. (NNIC). READ: 1.25M passengers seen at NAIA during ‘Undas’ travel rush That marked a 4.4-percent increase from the 1.24 million travelers recorded in 2025.
